name: aplicativo-web-ceya-arquitectura
description: Plataforma web de CEYA Arquitectura: monorepo frontend Next.js + backend Fastify.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ceya/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ceya/shared && npm run build -w @ceya/backend && npm run build -w @ceya/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ceya/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ceya/backend && npm run typecheck -w @ceya/frontend
